correctness.rationale: The signed deletion matrix uses ordered triples and distinct permutation columns. Govc's freeness theorem makes H1 torsion-free; by universal coefficients the difference in degree-two Betti numbers over F2 and Q is the top-boundary rank gap. Independently, after relabeling to contain 0123, contract its forward-edge tree and eliminate remaining forward edges with the increasing triangles. Each nonincreasing triple abc then gives the relation e_bc-e_ac+e_ab on the six backward-edge generators, with forward edges zero. Iterative OR-union of the nonincreasing triple masks of the other 23 facets gives 24,469 attainable sets of relations; exact integer-scaled elimination and binary elimination give the same rank in every case (rank histogram from 0 to 6: 1,3,13,96,366,2534,21456). Thus even without Govc there is no two-primary H1 torsion here; H0 and H3 cannot contain torsion. The empty generator set is harmless. Any top rank gap forces a binary dependence within a rational column basis, hence a rationally independent support of a nonzero binary-kernel vector. Independent code found rank 15, nullity 9, and 52 rationally independent supports among the 369 nonzero kernel supports of weight at most 12, all of weight 12 and all of binary rank 11. This proves both directions of the minimum-set census. It reproduced the five relabel/reversal orbits and all displayed representatives, full ordered two-skeletons, and Smith diagonals 1^11,2. For the full two-skeleton, contracting the three edges 1→a lets the triangles 1ab kill every edge between nonroot vertices, then a1b kills each a→1. The skeleton is simply connected and has H2 of rank 15 by Euler characteristic; Hurewicz and Whitehead give a wedge of fifteen S². The cycle lattice is primitive, so the same Smith diagonal classifies the twelve attaching classes in π2. Unimodular changes in domain and target are realized by sphere-wedge homotopy equivalences; the cofiber splits into eleven contractible summands, the degree-two Moore space, and three S² summands. The two-primary threshold, rather than an all-prime threshold, is what is proved.
